lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular clusters arranged in a semi-regular grid posterior to the gill slits, forming distinct vertical columns and horizontal rows.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the circular high-luminance blobs to form a visible grid-like structure across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Linear features running horizontally across the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient in pixel intensity.

other_distinctive_markers: High-density distribution of small high-luminance blobs on the pectoral fin and presence of multiple remoras in the lower field of view.
